user_input: How many PTO days do full-time employees accrue per year, and how many can roll over?
response: Full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per year under Policy HR-204, and up to 5 unused days may roll over into the next calendar year.
retrieved_contexts: HR-204 Paid Time Off: Full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per calendar year, credited monthly. A maximum of 5 unused PTO days may be carried over into the following calendar year; any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31.
HR-204 Appendix A: PTO accrual begins on the employee's first day of employment and is prorated for mid-year hires.
reference: Under Policy HR-204, full-time employees accrue 20 PTO days per year. Up to 5 unused days may roll over into the next calendar year.

user_input: How long is paid parental leave and what is the eligibility requirement?
response: Policy HR-311 provides 12 weeks of paid parental leave, and employees become eligible after 12 months of continuous service.
retrieved_contexts: HR-311 Parental Leave: Eligible employees receive 12 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth or adoption of a child. Eligibility requires 12 months of continuous employment prior to the leave start date.
HR-311 Section 4: Parental leave may be taken intermittently within the first 12 months after the child's arrival, subject to manager approval.
reference: Policy HR-311 grants 12 weeks of paid parental leave. Employees are eligible after 12 months of continuous service.

user_input: What is the deadline to submit expense reimbursement claims, and what is the per-meal cap?
response: Under Policy HR-118, expense reimbursement claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense, and the per-meal cap for domestic travel is 40 dollars.
retrieved_contexts: HR-118 Expense Reimbursement: Employees must submit reimbursement claims within 60 days of incurring the expense. Claims submitted after 60 days require VP approval.
HR-118 Travel Meal Limits: The reimbursable per-meal cap for domestic travel is 40 USD, inclusive of tax and gratuity.
reference: Policy HR-118 requires expense reimbursement claims to be submitted within 60 days. The per-meal cap for domestic travel is 40 dollars.

user_input: How much sick leave do employees get, and is a doctor's note required?
response: Policy HR-227 grants 10 paid sick days per year, and a doctor's note is required for absences longer than 3 consecutive days.
retrieved_contexts: HR-227 Sick Leave: Employees are entitled to 10 paid sick days per calendar year. Unused sick days do not roll over.
HR-227 Documentation: A physician's note is required for any sick absence exceeding 3 consecutive working days.

user_input: What is the remote work stipend amount and how often is it paid?
response: Policy HR-405 provides a 50-dollar monthly remote work stipend, paid on the last business day of each month.
retrieved_contexts: HR-405 Remote Work Stipend: Approved remote employees receive a 50 USD monthly stipend to offset home-office costs. The stipend is disbursed on the last business day of each month with regular payroll.
HR-405 Eligibility: The stipend applies to employees working remotely at least 3 days per week under an approved arrangement.
